name: Nexobind
description: Nexobind accelerates the integration of Synthetic Neural Tissue with organic nerve endings by flooding the interface zone with growth factors, adhesion proteins, and guided signaling peptides. What normally takes six to eight weeks of painful partial-integration can be compressed to ten to fourteen days. It is standard post-operative care following any SNT implantation procedure.
side_effects: vivid sensory hallucinations as new pathways fire unpredictably
rare cases of runaway axonal sprouting requiring surgical correction
emotional lability during peak bonding phase
duration: Active effect 6-8 hours per dose; treatment course 10-14 days
street_price: Φ90 per injection (clinic); Φ200 black market single dose
cultural_context: Nexobind is the difference between a clean SNT install and months of ghost-limb agony. Tier 2 workers getting their first neural labor interfaces rely on it. Tier 4 elites get the premium Helix formula with concierge dosing. On the Shelf, bootleg Nexobind analogs cause as many problems as they solve — runaway sprouting has left people with uncontrolled sensory feedback that never resolves.
story_hooks: A character is midway through an SNT bonding course when their Nexobind supply is cut off — the incomplete integration is causing sensory seizures
Bootleg Nexobind cut with a cheap growth stimulant has caused a cluster of axonal overgrowth cases on the Shelf — the victims hear everything as pain
Helix Biosystems' new Nexobind formula bonds SNT 40% faster — but early users report the new pathways feel like someone else is in their head
